name: branding-black-brand-collateral-and-welcome-kit-with-lime-arc-and-umbrella
title: Black stationery flat lay, welcome-kit box and umbrella with an electric lime arc and 'pilo' logo, plus testimonial
whatItIs: A board with a black flat lay (notebook, pen, lanyard, letter, envelope, cards, cup) and a welcome kit box (thermos, notebook, card, letter) all printed with a lime arc and white 'pilo' wordmark, a white panel with a black umbrella with a lime arc, and a text block with a lime testimonial card from a CEO.
whatItMeans: Sleek and confident; one lime arc turns black objects into a system.
techniques: Use a single lime arc as the brand graphic.
Keep all items black with white type.
Present a kit box and a hero object.
End with a lime testimonial card.

vocabulary.definition: A recurring curved shape used on items.
A branded box of onboarding items.
A coloured card with a client quote.
